Name: Directus prefab
Use case: Connecting your Noodl front end to a Directus back end

Name: Better Markdown component
Use case: Use instead of text component to manually style parts of a text
Notes: You need to install the 'Markdown' module in your Noodl editor for this to work

Name: Strobe / Blinking button
Use case: Making a button or group change colour with transitions that causes a repeating strobe effect

Name: Masonry grid for repeaters
Use case: Making a horizontal repeater with dynamic column sizes depending on child content width. Could be adapted for vertical repeaters
Notes: Add this to a 'CSS Definition' node at the same level as your repeater. Make a parent Group node for the repeater and give it the CSS class .masonry-grid. Then for the repeater items, make the parent group CSS class .masonry-grid-item

Name: Add params to URL
Use case: You're making an API call in a Function node and the API endpoint expects a list of URL encoded parameters

Name: Map new values to an existing array of items
Use case: You've got an array of items, and you want to add another value to each object.
Notes: The 'originRecordId : obj.id' part is there because the 'updatedJsonObjects' output items will each have a new 'id' in the outputted array. This is because Noodl assigns an array id and new item ids to each array it creates. So essentially you'll lose the Record Id of the items from your database query. If you want to reference the Record Ids later, this line will give you a new value in the outputted array called 'originRecordId' that you can feed into a Record node to find the original item in the database

Name: Make a reusable component have a code editor input
Use case: You're making a reusable component and you want to see the 'Edit code' button as one of the manual inputs of the component when it's being placed in the node graph
Notes: Replace graphql by javascript if you want the reguar editor, and the 'default' can just be "" for example

Name: Get a cloud function to return all fields from a class object, even the ACL
Use case: You want to read the array of ACL that was set on an object when it was created, or you want to see user / role relations on the _Role class
Notes: Replace CLASSNAME with the exact class name from your Parse database. This only works with the Noodl Parse backend. Connect up the id of the object you're looking for to Inputs.objectId

Name: Is Noodl in dev or production?
Use case: You want to diferentiate between the test and production environments.

Name: You want to bulk add or remove relations
Use case: You have a relations field and you want to bulk add relations without using the Run Tasks node or a for loop
Notes: Only works in back end cloud functions using the Noodl Parse back end

Name: Query Noodl database to find records where a relation field of that record contains the id of another record
Use case: You can easily query a target class to ask for any parent class records where the relation field contains the target class id. What's not obvious is making a query like "Get any parent records where the parent's relation field contains the id of a target record from another class"

Name: Check if a group is too near window bottom
Use case: You've got a dropdown menu as an absolute position group component, and when the element it's attached to is at the bottom of the screen, the dropdown menu overflows Y and can't be properly accessed. This script will output when the input is too close to the bottom of the screen, or not.
Notes: Must be run in a Script node. Best to connect "Did mount" of the element being tracked to the 'checkPosition' signal. Connect the 'This' output of the input element you want to track, not the dropdown itself. Change the 'distanceFromBottom' variable to suit your needs (example is set at 200px from window bottom)

Name: Multiple dropdowns with filtered results
Use case: You want to make one dropdown dependent on a parent dropdown, like select a company THEN select the employee
Notes: Coded by the very helpful Johan Olsson from Noodl

Name: Return all child records of a parents relation field
Use case: You have the parent id, and you want to query all children in the parent's relation field
Notes: NB: This only works as a cloud function

Name: Check window width
Use case: You need to output values based on the current window width to help with responsive styling
Notes: The outputs need to be repeated as shown in the code or else you won't get an initial value of window width on page load, only when the page is resized.

Name: Input mapping for repeater nodes
Use case: You want to map values from the items input of a Repeater to the component inputs in the repeater template
Notes: This code is only for the 'input mapping' script of the Repeater node

Name: Smooth scroll to bottom of a scrollable group
Use case: You've got a chat window and you need to scroll to the most recent message
Notes: I think 'Enable scroll' on the 'This' group in question is necessary for this to work, but not sure
